# 1 bed detached house for sale

> River Cottage is a charming and beautifully renovated 1 bedroom cottage, dating back to the early 1900s.The accommodation extends to approximately 51 sqm and comprises an inviting open-plan living, kitchen and dining area. The living room features an impressive double-height ceiling with exposed wooden beams, creating a wonderful sense of space and light.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 1 bed
- Plocha: 51 m²
- Energetická náročnost: G
- Lokalita: River Cottage, Feorus East, Kenmare
- Cena: 315 000 €
